properties.site-address: 18 Cedar Drive and land, adjacent, Edenbridge
properties.notes: Located within Edenbridge urban confines the site is considered sustainable. There is scope for expanding the retail element on the ground floor and providing flats above. Given the small scale nature of the site and its close proximity to existing residential units there are some concerns over amenity impacts which could be addressed through high quality design.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
